fact_english: The nipa palm's trunk grows underground in the mud; only its leaves and flower stalks rise above the surface.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang nipa, par, sa ilalim ng putik pala tumutubo ang katawan nito.

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Dahon at bulaklak lang ang lumilitaw. Mahiyain na palma.

after_text: Sa lente, kumislap ang huling medalyon, nakabaon sa bahura, sa ilalim ng tubig.
why_here: The 1521 Mactan sequence ends here on a mystery cliffhanger: the last medallion glints in the reef. After the break the story jumps back to the present with "Pagbalik namin sa kasalukuyan". Gap 125.606 to 126.376 (0.77 s), middle 125.99. Moved on 13 Nov from after sentence 17 because that spot put a joke on the eve of the battle, in the middle of the continuous telling (14-22) that ends with Magallanes' death. Grave episode: gentle plant fact.
